target_name: Physical Expansion During Own-History R&D Retrenchment
rationale: Internally consistent and the within-firm TS_RANK conditioning is a genuine departure from the archive's cross-sectional R&D gate, but the active leg is essentially the well-known asset/PP&E growth anomaly wrapped in the same product-of-ranks template that already produced the archive's winner, so incremental information is limited and the zero-R&D tie mass will make the gate nearly binary.

target_name: Plant Growth Deflated by Knowledge-Inclusive Capital
rationale: Clean, monotone, well-scaled construction of the classic investment-to-capital anomaly, but the R&D term in the denominator mechanically embeds a short-high-R&D tilt, so the signal is a blend of two known effects (I/K and R&D intensity) and a positive result will be hard to attribute to the stated deflator mechanism.

The active leg is the published employment/hiring-rate anomaly (Belo-Lin-Bazdresch) and the gate is verbatim the archive winner's RANK(NEG(xrd/sale)), so this is largely a known anomaly re-run through an already-tested conditioning template rather than a new cross-theme mechanism.

A bounded, economically interpretable share within a single investment budget that makes the buy-versus-build contrast explicit and is not in the archive; the main caveat is that it superimposes two separately documented effects (acquirer underperformance, R&D premium) with the same sign, and small-denominator firms will populate the tails.

This is close to a cosmetic re-specification of the archive's capex-minus-R&D acceleration signal (first difference of a bounded share instead of a difference of accelerations), and the COALESCE(xad,0) term is a real hazard since advertising reporting appears and disappears, injecting spurious jumps into a change-based measure.

target_name: Idle Cash Not Converted Into Knowledge
rationale: The agency-versus-innovation-funding distinction is a coherent and testable conditional story that cuts against the documented positive cash premium, though it is the third reuse of the same RANK(x)×RANK(NEG(R&D intensity)) template and cash and R&D are strongly positively correlated, so the high-signal corner will be a thin, possibly distressed set of firms.
